summary.oneLiner: Goldiam crossed INR 1,000 Cr revenue with record PAT, driven by a 'hybrid casting' model that mitigates US tariffs and expands margins by 200-300 bps. While B2B exports remain robust, the key growth optionality lies in scaling ORIGEM retail stores to 50 by FY27 end, targeting double-digit consolidated growth despite current B2C losses.

one-line thesis: Goldiam crossed INR 1,000 Cr revenue with record PAT, driven by a 'hybrid casting' model that mitigates US tariffs and expands margins by 200-300 bps. While B2B exports remain robust, the key growth optionality lies in scaling ORIGEM retail stores to 50 by FY27 end, targeting double-digit consolidated growth despite current B2C losses.
financial scorecard: Revenue: INR 2,433 Mn (Q4, +21% YoY), INR 12,123 Mn (FY26, +27.5% YoY); EBITDA: INR 583 Mn (Q4, +35.9% YoY), Margin 23.9% (includes other income); PAT: INR 372 Mn (Q4, +61% YoY), INR 1,706 Mn (FY26, +45.7% YoY); Order Book: INR 2,000 Mn as of Mar 31, 2026; Net Debt: Net Cash (Cash & Investments INR 4,934 Mn). One-offs: Q4 other expenses elevated due to one-off investment charges and pre-production costs for Q1.
guidance: Revenue Growth: Double-digit growth expected for FY27; Margin: EBITDA margins expected to expand further in FY27 (full year benefit of hybrid casting), incremental gross margin impact of 200-300 bps; Order Inflow: Robust demand in US bridal and new fashion segments; Capex/Commissioning: ORIGEM expansion to 45-50 stores by FY27 exit.
segment / subsidiary detail: B2B Exports: 88.3% of export sales mix from lab-grown diamond jewelry; Hybrid casting in US drives continuity and margins. B2C (ORIGEM): 24 operational stores (12 opened <60 days ago), Q4 revenue INR 55.6 Mn, April sales >INR 35 Mn. Targeting 45-50 stores by FY27 exit with INR 7 Cr/month run rate.
growth verticals / optionality: Expansion into high-ASP fashion jewelry (tennis bracelets/necklaces) in B2B; Scaling ORIGEM to 50 stores with mature store revenue target of INR 35-40 Lakhs/month; Sales enablers like 360 Ring Builder and old gold exchange.
margins & cost dynamics: Q4 EBITDA margin 23.9% (consolidated). Hybrid casting model expected to add 200-300 bps to gross margins annually by avoiding full duty on US-bound goods (duty only on Indian value addition). Q4 other expenses spiked due to one-offs.
capex / expansion: ORIGEM store setup cost ~INR 3.5 Cr/store (INR 2.5 Cr inventory, INR 50-60 Lakhs fit-out, INR 30-40 Lakhs deposit). No planned capex for expanding CVD machinery (currently 30 machines, 10% of consumption); focus on distribution ROE.
capital allocation: Bonus issue recommended (1:3); Strong cash balance (INR 4,934 Mn) funding ORIGEM expansion and working capital; No debt.
risks & watch-items: ORIGEM store-level profitability ramp-up (currently INR 15 Cr EBITDA loss for FY26); Competition in Indian lab-grown retail; US tariff policy changes (though mitigated by SEZ/US casting); Gold price volatility.
management quality / tone: Confident on margin expansion via hybrid casting; Aggressive on ORIGEM expansion but measured on store maturity (3-year payback); Transparent on one-offs and B2C losses.
non-obvious takeaways: Hybrid casting allows duty arbitrage where only Indian value-add is taxed, creating a structural moat against smaller competitors who cannot manage dual-country logistics. 64.5% of finished jewelry inventory is already with customers (consignment/stock-on-hand), smoothing future revenue recognition.
challenges → beneficiaries & losers:
| Challenge | Beneficiary/Loser | Dir | Conviction | Note |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Rising US tariffs on Indian jewelry imports | Goldiam International Ltd | beneficiary | High | Unique hybrid casting model (US casting + Indian finishing) minimizes duty impact to only value-add portion, unlike peers shipping fully made goods from India. |
| Consolidation of US jewelry supply chain favoring large players with US presence | Goldiam International Ltd | beneficiary | Med | Complexity of dual-casting and logistics creates barriers to entry, pushing smaller suppliers out and increasing wallet share with top US retailers. |

themes.title: B2B jewellery & lab-grown export
themes.need: B2B jewellery manufacturers and lab-grown diamond exporters ride wholesale/casting capacity, US/Europe export demand and GML financing - a manufacturing/export margin thesis, not retail FOCO store rollout.
themes.driver: Wholesale/casting capacity, lab-grown export demand (US/Europe) and GML financing.
